constraints.name: assignment_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((ended_at IS NULL) AND (ended_by IS NULL) AND (end_reason IS NULL)) OR ((ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (ended_by IS NOT NULL) AND (end_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(end_reason) <> ''::text))))

constraints.name: assignment_trip_id_tstzrange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (trip_id WITH =, tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: connection_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((last_confirmed_at IS NULL) AND (installation_id IS NULL) AND (message_id IS NULL)) OR ((last_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (installation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (message_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: deviation_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = ANY (ARRAY['late'::text, 'early'::text])) AND (trip_id IS NOT NULL) AND (point_no IS NOT NULL) AND (measured_value IS NOT NULL)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['off_route'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND (trip_id IS NOT NULL) AND (point_no IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'connection_lost'::text) AND (point_no IS NULL) AND (episode_started_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: deviation_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((closed_at IS NULL) AND (closed_by IS NULL) AND (close_reason IS NULL) AND (comment IS NULL)) OR ((closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at >= detected_at) AND (closed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (close_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (comment IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(comment) <> ''::text))))

constraints.name: deviation_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((close_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'unreliable_data'::text) OR (kind = ANY (ARRAY['late'::text, 'early'::text]))))

constraints.name: deviation_trip_id_point_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (trip_id, point_no) REFERENCES transport.passage(trip_id, point_no)

constraints.name: device_installation_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((ended_at IS NULL) AND (ended_by IS NULL) AND (end_reason IS NULL)) OR ((ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (ended_by IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(end_reason) <> ''::text) AND (end_reason IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: device_installation_device_id_tstzrange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (device_id WITH =, tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: device_installation_vehicle_id_tstzrange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (vehicle_id WITH =, tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: duty_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'planned'::text) AND (released_at IS NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'on_line'::text) AND (released_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'closed'::text) AND (released_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at >= released_at)) OR ((status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (released_at IS NULL) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: duty_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((closed_at IS NULL) AND (closed_by IS NULL) AND (close_reason IS NULL) AND (NOT unchecked_results)) OR ((closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (close_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(close_reason) <> ''::text))))

constraints.name: duty_driver_id_plan_span_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (driver_id WITH =, plan_span WITH &&) WHERE ((status = 'planned'::text))

constraints.name: duty_plan_span_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((plan_span IS NULL) OR ((NOT isempty(plan_span)) AND (NOT lower_inf(plan_span)) AND (NOT upper_inf(plan_span)) AND lower_inc(plan_span) AND (NOT upper_inc(plan_span)))))

constraints.name: duty_vehicle_id_plan_span_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (vehicle_id WITH =, plan_span WITH &&) WHERE ((status = 'planned'::text))

constraints.name: execution_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((actual_end IS NULL) OR ((actual_start IS NOT NULL) AND (actual_end >= actual_start))))

constraints.name: execution_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((interrupted_at IS NULL) OR ((actual_start IS NOT NULL) AND (interrupted_at >= actual_start))))

constraints.name: execution_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'done'::text) AND (actual_start IS NOT NULL) AND (actual_end IS NOT NULL) AND (completion_source IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'done'::text) AND (actual_end IS NULL) AND (completion_source IS NULL))))

constraints.name: execution_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'waiting'::text) OR ((actual_start IS NULL) AND (interrupted_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: execution_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'running'::text) OR ((actual_start IS NOT NULL) AND (next_point_no IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: execution_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'failed'::text) OR ((actual_start IS NULL) = (interrupted_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: execution_trip_id_next_point_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (trip_id, next_point_no) REFERENCES transport.trip_point(trip_id, point_no)

constraints.name: passage_trip_id_point_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (trip_id, point_no) REFERENCES transport.trip_point(trip_id, point_no)

constraints.name: passage_correction_trip_id_point_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (trip_id, point_no) REFERENCES transport.passage(trip_id, point_no)

constraints.name: planned_trip_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((refreshed_at IS NULL) AND (refreshed_by IS NULL) AND (refresh_reason IS NULL)) OR ((refreshed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (refreshed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (refresh_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(refresh_reason) <> ''::text))))

constraints.name: trip_decision_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((confirmed_end IS NULL) OR ((confirmed_start IS NOT NULL) AND ((confirmed_end >= confirmed_start) AND (confirmed_end <= decided_at)))))

constraints.name: trip_decision_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((interrupted_at IS NULL) OR ((confirmed_start IS NOT NULL) AND ((interrupted_at >= confirmed_start) AND (interrupted_at <= decided_at)))))

constraints.name: trip_decision_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((outcome = 'insufficient'::text) AND (status_before = 'review'::text) AND (status_after = 'review'::text) AND (confirmed_start IS NULL) AND (confirmed_end IS NULL) AND (interrupted_at IS NULL) AND (next_point_no IS NULL) AND (review_due_at IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'complete'::text) AND (status_before = 'review'::text) AND (status_after = 'done'::text) AND (confirmed_start IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_end IS NOT NULL) AND (interrupted_at IS NULL) AND (next_point_no IS NULL) AND (review_due_at IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'continue'::text) AND (status_before = 'review'::text) AND (status_after = 'running'::text) AND (confirmed_start IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_end IS NULL) AND (interrupted_at IS NULL) AND (next_point_no IS NOT NULL) AND (review_due_at IS NOT NULL) AND (review_due_at > decided_at)) OR ((outcome = 'fail'::text) AND (status_after = 'failed'::text) AND (confirmed_end IS NULL) AND (next_point_no IS NULL) AND (review_due_at IS NULL) AND ((confirmed_start IS NULL) = (interrupted_at IS NULL)))))

constraints.name: trip_decision_trip_id_next_point_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (trip_id, next_point_no) REFERENCES transport.trip_point(trip_id, point_no)
